questions.question: How much pain is your target customer experiencing?
questions.subtext: Rate out of 10 — don't choose 7 (it's the cop-out answer)

options.label: Health
options.description: Physical health, mental health, fitness, wellness

questions.question: How much money do they have to spend on a solution?
questions.subtext: Their annual income or budget for solving this problem

questions.question: How large of a sunk cost do they have in their existing solution?
questions.subtext: What have they already invested trying to solve this?

questions.question: What emotion are they feeling most strongly?
questions.subtext: The dominant emotional state driving them to seek a solution

options.label: Frustrated
options.description: They've tried things that didn't work

options.label: Overwhelmed
options.description: Too many options, don't know where to start

questions.question: Build your niche from your Flow Finder discoveries
questions.subtext: Select from your identified problems, personas, and skills. AI will craft your niche statement.

layers.label: Layer 3: Your Skill
layers.hint: How do you uniquely solve it?

questions.question: Why hasn't your audience solved their problem yet?
questions.subtext: These become the raw ingredients of your offer. Add at least 3 reasons per section.

sections.title: Vehicle Problems
sections.description: What's broken or missing in the solutions they've tried?
placeholders: e.g., 'Previous courses were too generic, not personalized'
e.g., 'They tried DIY but lacked the right system'
e.g., 'Other methods were too slow or complicated'

sections.title: Internal Beliefs
sections.description: What do they believe about themselves that holds them back?
placeholders: e.g., 'I'm not smart enough to figure this out'
e.g., 'I don't deserve success or happiness'
e.g., 'I'm too old/young to start now'

sections.title: External Beliefs
sections.description: What outside factors do they blame for blocking them?
placeholders: e.g., 'I can't afford to invest in this'

questions.question: What solutions could you offer?
questions.subtext: For each problem you identified, describe a solution that addresses it directly.

questions.question: Describe your Core Offer
questions.subtext: This is what people will pay for. Bring together your core product solution(s) and bonuses into one compelling offer.
questions.placeholder:
Describe:
• What transformation does it deliver?
• What's included (core + bonuses)?
• What makes it unique?
• What results will they get?

questions.question: Describe your Lead Magnet MVP
questions.subtext: This is your free value that proves you can help. Keep it simple but impactful.
questions.placeholder:
Describe:
• What will they get for free?
• How does it prove you can help?
• What result will they see quickly?
• How long will it take you to build?
